analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions maintained a wait-and-see approach. RSI at 47.7 continues in neutral territory, and MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. ADX at 31.2 indicates a clear trend, but with -DI above +DI, selling pressure is dominant. Despite 5 consecutive daily gains, the resistance at 95,720 KRW was not breached. Considering the ATR of 4.56%, entry carries risk.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading sessions. RSI rose from 36.5 to 47.7, and ADX trend strengthening continued. Today, RSI remains neutral at 47.7, and ADX trend strengthening persists at 31.2. Despite 5 consecutive daily gains, the failure to break resistance maintains the wait-and-see approach.
